Container.Name: roleplay-server
Container.Overview:
Fully local AI roleplay chat. Imports SillyTavern V2 character cards, streams replies from a model on your own GPU, and keeps long conversations coherent with rolling summarization. Nothing leaves your server.
INSTALL roleplay-ollama FIRST and pull a model into it.
IMPORTANT — set "Ollama URL" below to your Unraid server's LAN IP, not localhost and not a container name. Containers on Unraid's default bridge network cannot resolve each other by name, so http://ollama:11434 will NOT work here. Use http://192.168.x.x:11434. (If you put both containers on the same user-defined custom network, name resolution does work and you can use http://roleplay-ollama:11434 instead.)

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Chats, characters and imported card images. Small — safe on the cache drive.

Config.Name: Ollama URL
Config.Description: Your Unraid server's LAN IP plus the Ollama port. NOT localhost — that resolves to this container, not the host.

Config.Name: Model
Config.Description: Must already be pulled into the Ollama container: docker exec -it roleplay-ollama ollama pull HammerAI/smart-lemon-cookie

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID for appdata files. Unraid default is 99 (nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID for appdata files. Unraid default is 100 (users).

Config.Name: Context tokens
Config.Description: Model context window. MythoMax L2 is Llama-2 based: 4096. Do not raise this beyond what your model supports.

Config.Name: Temperature
Config.Description: Higher is more creative and less coherent.

Config.Name: Summarization enabled
Config.Description: Condense old turns so chats stay coherent past the context window.

Config.Name: Summary trigger tokens
Config.Description: Fold once un-summarized history exceeds this many tokens.

Config.Name: Database URL
Config.Description: Leave as-is unless you know why you're changing it.

Config.Name: Data dir
Config.Description: Leave as-is. Must match the Appdata mount above.
